name: dvfonts
description: Open Dhivehi fonts for the web, and the @yashau/thaana packages that make Thaana work everywhere.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' run build && pnpm --filter @dvfonts/web run build
scripts.check: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @dvfonts/web run check
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @dvfonts/web run dev
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @dvfonts/web run deploy
